description: This file defines React hooks and utility functions for interacting with payroll and credit entries in a dealer management system. It includes normalization of payload data, building query parameters, computing summary totals, and hooks for listing, creating, updating, and deleting payroll credit entries.

methods.name: normalizeEntriesList(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes different possible payload shapes into a flat array of entries.

methods.name: normalizePayrollCreditEntry(item)
methods.description: Transforms a raw item into a standardized payroll/credit entry object used by the UI.

methods.name: buildQuery({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {})
methods.description: Constructs query parameters object for API calls, excluding empty values.

methods.name: computePayrollCreditsSummary(entries)
methods.description: Calculates totals and counts for credits and payrolls, and net outstanding from entries.

methods.name: usePayrollCreditsList({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {})
methods.description: Hook to fetch payroll/credit list with filtering options.

methods.name: useCreatePayrollCredit()
methods.description: Hook to create a new payroll or credit entry.

methods.name: useUpdatePayrollCredit(entryId)
methods.description: Hook to update an existing payroll or credit entry by ID.

methods.name: useDeletePayrollCredit(entryId)
methods.description: Hook to delete a payroll or credit entry by ID.

ctags.name: buildQuery
ctags.pattern: /^function buildQuery({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {}) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {})

ctags.name: usePayrollCreditsList
ctags.pattern: /^export function usePayrollCreditsList({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {}) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ dealerId, kind, status, from, to, q } = {})
